name: Ramp
text: DECISION: Add a single, high-contrast focus ring that appears immediately on keyboard focus, with no delay. This ensures keyboard users always see clear visual feedback, preventing confusion and frustration. The trade-off is that it may feel slightly more intrusive to some users, but usability for people who rely on keyboard navigation outweighs this minor aesthetic concern.
